senses.gloss: Seraglio,Ⓒs.ⒹaMtaHpuraM, avaroDaH, SudDAMtaH, aM-targfhaM; See Ha-em.

Serene,Ⓒa.Ⓓpra-, SAMta, prasanna, akzubDa, stimita, sTira, nirudvega; nirAkula, anudvigna; (sky) niraBra, vitimira, prasanna; (water) viSada, svacCa, SudDa, nir-vi-a-mala, prasanna.
Ⓝ[Serene]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹprasannaM, saprasAdaM, SAMta-prasanna-cetasA.
Ⓝ[Seren]ity, [Serene]ness,Ⓒs.ⒹpraSAMti f., prasAdaH, anudvegaH, asaMBramaH, akzoBaH, prasannatA, niraBratA, nirmalatA.

Series,Ⓒs.ⒹmAlA, paraMparA, rAjiH, SreRiH-RI, AvaliH-lI, paMktiH, (all f.); dAman f. n., paryAyaH, paripAwi-wI f. AnupUrvI-rvyaM.
ⓃSerial,Ⓒa.Ⓓkramika, yaTAkrama, kramAnusArin.

Serious,Ⓒa.Ⓓga(gaM)BIra, DIra; gaMBIravftti-SIla-svaBAva; DIradarSana-svaBAva; ‘a s(erious) look’ DIravilokitaM.
Ⓑ
 2 guru, alaGu, anupekzya, ana-tipAtya, gurvarTa.
Ⓑ
 3 aparihAsin, avinodaSIla; ‘this is in truth, a s(erious) matter’ na Kalu ayaM parihAsasya vizayaH (Mal. 9); See Earnest.
Ⓝ[Serious]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹgaMBIraM, DIraM, saDEryaM, gOraveRa.
Ⓑ
 2 aparihAsena, satyaM; ‘I tell you s(eriously)’ na parihasAmi, nAyaM vinodaH, na parihAsaH.
Ⓝ[Serious]ness,Ⓒs.ⒹgAMBIryaM, DIratA, DEryaM, gOravaM, gurutA; aparihAsaH, avinodaH, &c.

Serpent,Ⓒs.ⒹsarpaH, BujagaH, BujaMgaH-gamaH, ahiH, pannagaH, nAgaH, uragaH; See Snake.
Ⓝ[Serpent]ine,Ⓒa.Ⓓ(s.) in comp.; vi-, sarpin, vakra, kuwila; ‘s(erpentine) course’ BujaMgagatiH, vakrA-kuwilA-gatiH.
Serrate, [Serrat]ed,Ⓒa.ⒹkarapatraniBa, krakacatulya anukrakaca, krakacaDAra, daMtura, sacCeda.

Serve,Ⓒv. t.Ⓓsev 1 A, Sru desid. (SuSrUzate) upAs 1 A, upasTA 1 A, upacar 1 P, pari-anu-car; ‘he who s(erve)s not anotherʼs will’ parecCAnurUpaM na vartate, paracCedAnuvartI na Bavati, anyaBAvaM na anupraviSati.
Ⓑ
 2 anu-vft 1 A, anuruD 4 A, anuvi-DA 3 U; See Obey.
Ⓑ
 3 upakf 8 U, anugrah 9 P, upacar, sAhAyyaM kf; SreyaH-saM-pad c.
Ⓑ
 4 (arTaM) sAD c., pravft c., saM-pad c., nirvft c.
Ⓑ
 5 paryApta-ucita a. BU 1 P, alaM with dat. or inf., kxp 1 A (with dat.); ‘this will s(erve) to rouse his anger’ tasya kopamuddIpayitu-kopoddIpanAya-alaM or paryAptamidaM.
Ⓑ
 6 upa-pari-kxp c., upasTA c. (sTApayati).
Ⓑ
 7 sTAne-BUmO-vft or BU or prayuj pass.
Ⓑ
 8 pra-upa-yuj 7 U, 10, vini-yuj, nikzip 6 P.
Ⓑ
 9 vft; Acar, vyava-hf 1 P, (with loc. of person); See Act, Behave; ‘s(erve) the purpose of’, ‘s(erve) as’ upayogaM vraj 1 P, sTAne-BUmO-BU; BUrja-tvacaH vrajaMti vidyADarasuMdarIRAmanaMgaleKakriya yopayogaM (K. i. 7) ‘s(erve) as love-letters’ &c.; ‘s(erve) up meals’ pariviz c., annaM upasTA c.; ‘the Gods s(erv)ed up food’ marutaH parivezwAraH Asan; ‘s(erve) out’ pratikf, vEraM &c. niryat 10.
Ⓔv. i.ⒹsevAM-kAryaM-kf; niyo-gamanuzWA 1 P; kAryaM saMpad c.; ‘this will s(erve) as water to wash his feet with’ idaM pAdodakaM Bavizyati (S. 1).
Ⓝ[Serv]ant,Ⓒs.ⒹBftyaH, sevakaH, kiMkaraH, anu-upa-jIvin m., dAsaH, cewaH, prezyaH, anu-pari-caraH, parijanaH, paricArakaH, niyojyaH, BujizyaH, SuSrUzakaH, upAsakaH, sevAjIvin m., vEtanikaH, BftiBuj m., BaraRyaBuj m., BftakaH; karmaka(kA)raH, (labourer); ‘female s(ervant)’, ‘s(ervant)-maid’ cewI, dAsI, BujizyA, prezyA, karmakarI, sEraM(riM)DrI.
ⓃService,Ⓒs.ⒹsevA, SuSrUzA, upacAraH, upa-pari-caryA, upAsanaM-nA; A-saM-SryaH; ‘s(ervice) of kings’ nfpasaMSrayaH, rAjASrayaH.
Ⓑ
 2 (State) dAsyaM, dAsavftti f., prezya-Bftya-BAvaH, sevA; ‘he lives in my s(ervice)’ sa mAmanujIvati madASritaH.
Ⓑ
 3 anuvartanaM, anuvfttiH, ArADanaM; See Obedience.
Ⓑ
 4 vfttiH, niyogaH, kAryaM, vyavasAyaH; vyApAraH, karman n., vyavahAraH.
Ⓑ
 5 upakAraH, sAhAyyaM, upakftaM-ti f., anugrahaH, hitaM, arTaH.
Ⓑ
 6 upayogaH, vyavahAraH.
Ⓑ
 7 saparyA, upAsanA, pUjA, upacAraH, pUjopacAraH.
Ⓑ
 8 [] BojanapAtragaRaH; ‘I am entirely at your s(ervice)’ sarvaTA tvadaDInohaM, BavatA yaTecCaM niyujyatAmayaM dAsaH; ‘in whose s(ervice) are you’ kasya sevayA jIvasi, kena niyuktastvaM; ‘to keep in s(ervice)’ sevAyAM niyuj 7 U, 10, (karmaRi) vyApf c.
Ⓝ[Servic]able,Ⓒa.Ⓓupayukta; upayogin, upakArin, sahAyaBUta, pra-upa-yojya.
Ⓑ
 2 kAryakzama, karmakuSala, alaMkarmIRa.
Ⓝ[Servic]ably,Ⓒadv.ⒹsopayogaM, salABaM, so-pakAraM.
ⓃServile,Ⓒa.ⒹdAseya (yI f.), dA-socita, dAsa-dAsya in comp.; ‘s(ervile) state’ dAsaBAvaH, dAsyaM, prezyaBAvaH, dAsyavfttiH.
Ⓑ
 2 aticAwupara, atyanuroDin, Svavftti, ati-lAlanapara.
Ⓝ[Servil]ity,Ⓒs.ⒹdAsyaM, dAsyaBAvaH.
Ⓑ
 2 caraRAvapAtaH, SvavfttiH, atilAlanaM, atyanu-roDaH, CaMdonuvartanaM.
Ⓝ[Servile]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹdAsavat, atya-nuroDena, atilAlanapUrvaM^1.
ⓃServitor,Ⓒs.Ⓓse-vakaH, BftyaH, &c.; See Servant.
ⓃServitude,Ⓒs.ⒹdAsyaM, BftyaBAvaH, kiMkaratvaM, sevA, prezyaBAvaH, SvavfttiH, sevADarmaH, sevaka-daSA.
